pr_body:
This hard-codes useReproposalsV2 to true (prior to this PR, it's metamorphic with a default of true) and applies the resulting simplifications across the codebase.

These include simplified control flow and an overall simplified architecture.

Closes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/105625.

Epic: CRDB-25287
Release note: None

issue_context.title: kvserver: phase out useReproposalsV2
issue_context.body:
This is introduced in https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/97779 to keep both the old and new way of reproposing with a new lease applied index around.

In a few weeks, we should remove the old way, i.e. hard-code `useReproposalsV2` to `true` and simplify code based on that.

Epic: CRDB-25287

Jira issue: CRDB-29130

review_comments: nit: V2 rename should be in previous commit, or alternatively just squash the entire commit into it.
